Residential) zoning districts. The subject properties are located around the
intersection of North Meridian Road and East Rodeo Lane, Kuna, Idaho 83634.

Richard Hersey, 2202 Meridian Road, Kuna, Idaho 83634, lived at the end of lane
and was concerned with the amount of property he would lose when the road was
developed. He indicated he had a copy of an agreement to give the property for road
way but neither he nor his wife signed it. He didn't know where their signatures
came from.
6. Public Hearings: (6:00 p.m. or as soon thereafter as matters may be heard.)
Applicant Larry Hansen thanked Council and asked for approval.
Support: None

Council President Buban-Vonder Haar stated the application complied with the
Comprehensive Plan and other relevant authorities. She asked if Council had any
thoughts on it. She had read through the Findings of Fact and Conclusions of Law
and endorsed those as written.

Mr. Weiger indicated the applicant would maintain the road as private and this
application was only for annexation. The road would be part of future development
applications

Mayor Stear asked Mr. Hersey if Ada County had a copy of the document he said
did not have his signature on it.

Mayor Stear asked Mr. Weiger if they would still be noticed on that and when it
would happen.
Mr. Weiger stated yes.

Council President Buban-Vonder Haar moved approve 19-05-AN (Annexation)
with conditions as listed except item number 8 removed and close the Public
Hearing and approve Findings of Fact, Conclusions of Law and Order of
Decision as included in the packet. Seconded by Council Member McPherson.
Motion carried 4-0.

Mayor Stear asked Mr. Weiger if it would actually come back when they went to
Plat the property.
Mr. Hersey replied he had a copy of the paper.

Mayor Stear clarified to Mr. Hersey that he would be noticed again before the next
process began and nothing could happen to the road at this point.

Mayor Stear thanked Mr. Weiger and asked what the opinion of the Council was. He
clarified the road issue would not be an issue until the platting occurred. He asked if
there would be issues with that road that would have to be taken care of later.

Page 4 of 7
Kuna City Council Minutes August 20, 2019

Mayor Stear asked Mr. Weiger to provide information regarding what Mr. Hersey
discussed.
Mr. Weiger confirmed that was correct.
Mr. Weiger replied that was correct.

Mayor Stear agreed it was a good idea and gave the direction to allow approval of
Findings of Fact and Conclusions of Law with the packet instead of putting them off
to the following City Council Meeting.

City Clerk Chris Engels reviewed the conversation from the August 6, 2019 Council
